name: symphony
description: Persistent, recoverable project routing through assessed, task-sized execution leads and workflow capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent routing through task-sized execution leads.
interface.longDescription: Symphony makes the root a thin session keeper, uses a strong read-only assessor to select an exact route, and assigns execution, delegation, integration, and verification to a task-sized lead. Lifecycle hooks protect normal stopping and recover interrupted runs. Each task selects direct, mixed, or delegation-heavy execution and uses the workflow and evidence capabilities actually available.
